description: The pie chart presents the distribution of video/content categories, shown as 14 slices with percentage labels inside each segment and category names placed around the perimeter, without a separate legend. The slices are: People Blogs (orange, ~17.2%), Entertainment (purple, ~13.9%), Howto Style (green, ~9.7%), Education (red, ~8.7%), Sports (pink, ~7.7%), Gaming (gray, ~6.4%), Science Technology (blue, ~6.4%), Comedy (light blue, ~5.6%), Autos Vehicles (red, ~4.8%), Travel Events (yellow, ~4.6%), Film Animation (brown, ~4.6%), News Politics (orange, ~4.3%), Pets Animals (green, ~3.9%), and Music (light purple, ~2.3%). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear to follow a strictly descending or ascending order by size.
